title: API Proposal: `onHit` callback in hits widget

comments.body: Agreed with the feature, but not with the name. `onHit` hints as an event (like `.on('results')`), I would go for something that hints at a hook or callback. Maybe `beforeRender` or `transformHit`.

Maybe `transform` or `transformData` alone would be good? So that we can reuse it for other widgets?

Dunno if `transformData` is really native-compliant :D

I would expect `transformData` to pass the whole API response, `transformHits` to only pass the `.hits` part and `transformHit` to pass me only one hit. It really depend on what we want to expose (I personnaly prefer `transformHit` here).

Ok so `transformHit` looks good but what about other widgets? `transformFacetValue` `transformData` (stats) `transformXX`?

I like `transformHit` only worried that we will then need a lot of other tokens.

Maybe `transformData` (full data, stats, toggle..) and `transformItems` (any list-based)?
I think we only need it for the `hits` widget today. Maybe just wait for the need on other widgets before merging?
Works for me :+1:  (I would not mention `hogan` in the parameter name however)

> (I would not mention hogan in the parameter name however)

Well but it will always be a hogan function here, I mean you need to pass a hogan template (or a mustache one).

> Well but it will always be a hogan function here, I mean you need to pass a hogan template (or a mustache one).

Yes, rather `mustache` than `hogan` then :)
Yes, I like the transformData too. @Jerskouille care to submit an issue with API proposal?
